# Caraka

> A thin bridge from Telegram to the coding agent already installed on your machine. Every task lives in its own topic, like tabs in a terminal, with approvals, streaming progress, and memory that can explain itself. Caraka has no agent loop, no execution tools, and no plugin marketplace: the coding agent already has all of those.

Caraka speaks [ACP](https://agentclientprotocol.com), the LSP-equivalent for coding agents, so one client covers 28+ agents including Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Cline, Goose and Amp. Memory uses [Titen](https://titen.dev), which separates observation, claim, and context so a conclusion is never confused with the evidence behind it. Status: pre-alpha, MIT, Node ≥ 22.

## Specification

- [PRD](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/prd.md): problem, users, goals, non-goals, scope
- [FRD](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/frd.md): functional requirements by module, FR-ids
- [BRD](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/brd.md): market, positioning, business requirements
- [Design](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/design.md): architecture, interfaces, ACP and CLI driver contracts
- [ERD](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/erd.md): data model, integrity rules, retention
- [Session model](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/session-model.md): sessions as Telegram topics, lifecycle, routing, housekeeping
- [Telegram integration](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/telegram-integration.md): Bot API 10.2 mapping
- [Security](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/security.md): threat model, mandatory controls, policy modes
- [Tech stack](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/techstack.md): choices with the alternatives that were rejected
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/roadmap.md): phases and decision gates

## Research

Every claim in the specification traces to one of these.

- [ACP](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/research/acp-protokol-universal-agentclientprotocol-jetbrains-morph.md): the universal protocol
- [Agent integration matrix](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/research/coding-agents-matriks-integrasi-multi-sumber.md): per-agent routes

- [Prerequisites and cost](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/research/prasyarat-biaya-dan-jalur-gratis.md): pricing verified August 2026, and the free path
